ns2:section.sectionText: This section is restricted to students in the Actuarial Science Program. The Actuarial Science Program is applying for University-Earned Credit status for this class to be part of a sequence of courses covering Exam SRM. Information will be updated when available to confirm whether the application is successful. Other sections of STAT 420/ASRM 450 will NOT be eligible for UEC credit. Actuarial students with questions about UEC credit should contact an advisor at asrm-advising@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Predictive Analytic Risk Mgmt major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
